title: Equivalent fractions · recall sheet
source: Original elementary arithmetic brief; verified by cross multiplication.
copy:
Exact title: "Equivalent fractions". Subtitle: "Recall it before you reveal it". Three numbered questions with spacious empty ruled answer areas:
1. Complete: 1/2 = __/6
2. Complete: 2/3 = __/9
3. Why is 1/2 not equal to 1/4?
Visual exercise: Two equal-length empty fraction bars: one divided into two equal cells and one divided into six equal cells. Small instruction: Shade equivalent amounts. No cells prefilled.
At the bottom a separated pale answer panel below a dotted horizontal divider. Exact panel header: "Cover before answering". Answers numbered to match:
1. 3/6.
2. 6/9.
3. The same whole is split into more parts; one part is smaller.
invocation: Use $memory-drills to explain equivalent fractions for a beginner. Include three retrieval questions, blank writing space and a covered answer panel. Use Warm cream dot-grid paper, peach and lavender highlighter, oversized hand-lettered title, precise ink diagrams.
